note: A view fixes which scans a protocol trains on, selects on, and tests on. Every fitted statistic (latent standardization, age scaling, population drift) comes from the view's train rows only. Members are [cohort, split] pairs; split 'all' means the whole strict cohort.

p1_external_aibl_testsplit.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on the AIBL test split.

p1_external_aibl_wholecohort.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on every AIBL subject.

p1_external_oasis_testsplit.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on the OASIS test split.

p1_external_oasis_wholecohort.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on every OASIS subject.

p1_external_calsnic_testsplit.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on the CALSNIC test split (ALS is out of distribution).

p1_external_calsnic_wholecohort.description: ADNI-trained, zero-shot on every CALSNIC subject.

p4_loco_without_adni.description: Train AIBL+OASIS, test all of ADNI.

p4_loco_without_aibl.description: Train ADNI+OASIS, test all of AIBL.

p4_loco_without_oasis.description: Train ADNI+AIBL, test all of OASIS.

p4b_exp1_aibl_to_adni_oasis.description: BrainODE Exp1 replica: train AIBL, test all of ADNI and OASIS.

p4c_exp2_pooled_to_calsnic.description: BrainODE Exp2 analog: pooled training, test all of CALSNIC (Control = unseen cohort, ALS = OOD condition).

crossfit.description: Subject-level 5-fold cross-fitting: fold k is test, fold k+1 is the inner validation, the rest is train.
